products.notes: Reference values for a full-spec 1/0 AWG copper conductor: area 53.5 mm2 (ASTM B258 nominal), resistance 0.3224 mOhm/m solid copper at 20 C (conductivity 58.0 MS/m = 100% IACS annealed copper). Stranded cable is ~2-3% higher. Copper tempco +0.393%/C: multiply by (1+0.00393*(T-20)). Ampacity omitted: depends on insulation rating, bundling, length and allowed voltage drop. Many car-audio cables labelled '1/0 AWG' are undersized - measure strand area when possible.

Generic copper-clad aluminium 1/0 AWG at full 53.5 mm2: resistance = copper value x 1.6 (aluminium core ~61% IACS; CCA typically 1.5-1.65x copper). Approximation for voltage-drop estimates only; real CCA kits are often also undersized vs. the AWG label. Tempco ~ +0.40%/C.
